triples.tail_surface: standstill damage to shaft seal and bearings
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 轴封和轴承的停机损坏
triples.evidence_text: On pumps not running, the shaft shall be rotated at least 2-3 times monthly to avoid standstill damage to shaft seal and bearings.

triples.tail_surface: standstill damage to shaft seal and bearings
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 轴封和轴承的停机损坏
triples.evidence_text: On pumps not running, the shaft shall be rotated at least 2-3 times monthly to avoid standstill damage to shaft seal and bearings.

triples.head_surface: seizing of the impeller and/or the shaft seal
triples.evidence_text: In special applications, it may require more frequent shaft rotation or start-up in order to avoid seizing of the impeller and/or the shaft seal.

triples.head_surface: more frequent shaft rotation or start-up
triples.tail_surface: seizing of the impeller and/or the shaft seal
triples.evidence_text: In special applications, it may require more frequent shaft rotation or start-up in order to avoid seizing of the impeller and/or the shaft seal.

triples.tail_surface: the shaft seal often leaks a bit during standstill
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 停机期间轴封常有轻微泄漏
triples.evidence_text: In pressurized systems, the shaft seal often leaks a bit during standstill – in most cases the leakage stops shortly after the pump is started up.

triples.head_surface: lead liquid (either one way or the other) through a passively rotating pump
triples.head_canonical_zh: 液体流过被动旋转的泵
triples.evidence_text: It is not recommended to lead liquid (either one way or the other) through a passively rotating pump, as this may damage the shaft seal.
